review.reviewBody: We had a great time chatting with people from various countries. The cooking class was well-suited and very interesting.
David was an amazing chef and instructor. We enjoyed this class so much!

My solo trip was an amazing experience, allowing me to connect with people from all over the world. The chef was fantastic, always willing to help and share techniques and answering any questions we had. We even added our pasta to be cooked together, which made it even more delicious. Would do again!
Our chef Lorenzo was fun, knowledgeable, and encouraging - thoroughly enjoyed making pasta, bonus with the wine!
Eduardo is a wonderful guide! Nice group. Everything was fun, with jokes. Highly recommended!

The spaces are modern and beautiful!Leonardo, our chef, was energetic, welcoming and friendly! He was funny and respectful. An excellent teacher. The food was delicious, flavorful, and plentiful!!!! The price is more than reasonable! An activity not to be missed!

Our course was delayed by 20 minutes due to the volume of people having booked classes and being checked in so actually our course was closer to 90 minutes, however Chef Jacob was engaging, funny, patient and very clear with his instructions. The cooking class was exactly as described and was totally good fun, as we're all the other people in our class which made it even better. Do not miss booking the course and would recommend the evening class if you are thinking in enjoying the free wine
Eno was great, very helpful, fun, and engaging with the class. We had an excellent time and met some wonderful people from Belgium!

texts.text: Create 3 types of fresh pasta, such as ravioli, tortelli, and pappardelle
Learn each process from the basics with chef as your instructor
You will eat everything you cook and drink wine as much as you want
Learn to cook inside the historic medieval tower
Eat everything you cook, paired with Tuscan wine and soft drinks

Learn to make FRESH PASTA, like our grandmothers made them in Italy.
We will teach you every process and stand by you teaching you every step.

Our COOKING SCHOOL is located inside a MEDIEVAL TOWER from the 1200s, a stone's throw from Brunelleschi's Dome. Where you will breathe the air and life of Dante Alighieri, father of the Italian language because the tower where we will cook belonged to his wife's family.
Our team is made up of true chefs, with many years of experience in the best Italian cuisines.

From FLOUR to RAGÙ, together we will make real Italian pasta from scratch as they did it in the times of the Medici family, the lords of the Renaissance.

We will PREPARE 3 TYPES of FRESH PASTA such as RAVIOLI, TORTELLI and PAPPARDELLE, and at the same time we will also prepare sauces to match such as butter and sage, arrabbiata and old-fashioned Tuscan ragù.

You will not have to bring anything with you because all the equipment will be offered by us. In the end we will eat everything we have prepared.

During the experience we can drink good TUSCAN WINE or unlimited drinks.
